notifications.title: The Holy City was struck
notifications.body: Its Sanctity fell to 0.

notifications.title: The Holy City has fallen
notifications.body: The walls are breached and the sanctuary fires are out. The hordes pour over the Kalinov Bridge unopposed. Some of the people escaped into the forests, carrying the songs with them; perhaps one day they will try again.

notifications.title: You's refuge was raided
notifications.body: The horde carried off 375 resources after 1 rounds.

notifications.title: You's refuge is under attack
notifications.body: A horde of 12 is fighting your garrison of 0.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to You's refuge
notifications.body: The low north horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Autumn has come
notifications.body: The harvest is in and the ground is firm: every soldier holds 20% better. The Order marches half as often again; the nomads go home to winter.

notifications.title: Captives are held at (2, 6)
notifications.body: Clear the camp to free them before they are taken away, for a bounty of at least 3150 resources. If they are taken, the next horde from the south hates you the more.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 1 of them against its guard of 33.

notifications.title: A refuge by the Holy City
notifications.body: You's refuge takes in your people at (-1, 2).

notifications.title: Achievement: Ashes
notifications.body: Lose a village to a horde.

notifications.title: Vruchiy was razed
notifications.body: Only ruins are left. Rebuild them, or start over from what remains.

notifications.title: Dobrynya is wounded
notifications.body: Back on their feet in a few hours.

notifications.title: Vruchiy is being razed
notifications.body: The horde broke the defenders after 1 rounds and is burning the village.

notifications.title: Vruchiy is under attack
notifications.body: A horde of 1 is fighting your garrison of 0.

notifications.title: A horde is coming to Vruchiy
notifications.body: The severe north horde arrives within the hour. Check the garrison and its stance.

notifications.title: Achievement: The Black God Walks
notifications.body: See the Avatar of Černobog rise.

notifications.title: The Avatar of Černobog walks at (1, -3)
notifications.body: The ritual is done. The Black God takes flesh and marches on the villages. Slay it for a great bounty.

notifications.title: The Holy City held
notifications.body: The horde was beaten at its walls after 2 rounds.

notifications.title: A horde is at the Holy City
notifications.body: 9 of them against its guard of 30.

notifications.title: Summer has come
notifications.body: The fields ripen: twice the grain. The steppe riders ride twice as often; the Order's armies, slow in the heat, half as often.

notifications.title: Boatwrights wait at (-8, 2)
notifications.body: Send them resources from your villages, and they build a boat that carries armies and caravans fast along the river, with a bounty of at least 2800 resources for everyone. If nobody does, the next horde from the north hates you the more.

notifications.title: The forbidding ruin at (2, 2) sank back into the earth
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +20% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Today in Siege
notifications.body: 1 update, 2 builds finished

notifications.title: Spring has come
notifications.body: The thaw: the land wakes, and every front stirs alike.

notifications.title: Cultists of Černobog gather at (1, -3)
notifications.body: They work a dark ritual. Scatter them before it ends, for a bounty of at least 2450 resources; every soldier who falls fighting them brings its end nearer. If it ends, something terrible walks.

notifications.title: The boatwrights at (-6, 4) gave up and left
notifications.body: The next horde from the north hates you the more for it: +40% attack and defense.

notifications.title: Winter has come
notifications.body: Snow on the fields: no grain at all, the stores must last. The Monsters of the North come twice as often.

notifications.title: A forbidding ruin rises at (2, 2)
notifications.body: Strong guardians watch it, and rich finds lie within, for a while. Searching it brings a bounty of at least 2100 resources; left alone, it rouses the next horde from the north.

notifications.title: The Builders' Barrow rises
notifications.body: The first builders sleep in the Builders' Barrow with their mark, the rune that bound the old span to Yav. Their dead still guard it: break through and bring the rune back, or no stone will hold the new span. It is marked on the map at (0, -5).
